intro: Oil and diamonds dominate Angola's economy.

chapters.title: Oil
text: Angola is one of Africa's top oil producers; oil makes up most exports. It is also a major diamond producer.
The Lobito Corridor railway is being upgraded to carry minerals to the coast.

chapters.title: Farming
text: Coffee was once a big export and is being revived.
